definition: For each group/stage, signed=sum(Q(5)+QV)*DEN*DELZ; half-L1=0.5*(sum(abs(Q(5)))+abs(QV))*DEN*DELZ; summed over columns.
interpretation_limits: Diagnostics are same-call request activity, not reaction throughput or a closed conservation budget.
Column sums use actual same-call DEN*DELZ weights; no horizontal area is available in KDM62D.
Each arm records its actual status and completed prefix; a successful attempt must cover every step in its receipt-bound schedule.
Historical V17 rates are not copied or used as a baseline.
ratio_definition: applied/proposed and deferred/proposed for signed and half-L1 totals; zero denominator is status ZERO_DENOMINATOR with null ratio.
scope: Both requested 120-second runs completed all 6 steps; each compact summary was fully parsed.
